A♥.name: ACE OF HEARTS
A♥.under: You hand someone a feeling that is bigger than the moment can hold and expect them to carry it. They never agreed to that weight.
A♥.sweet_spot: You say what you feel on purpose, then let the silence sit until the other person answers.
A♥.over: Your moods start setting the terms, and people tiptoe around you instead of getting to know you.

2♥.name: 2 OF HEARTS
2♥.under: You go along with the restaurant, the plan and the opinion. Months later you can't remember choosing anything you wanted.
2♥.sweet_spot: You put your needs next to theirs and leave the disagreement out in the open where both of you can deal with it.
2♥.over: Their bad mood becomes your job. You lose yourself in managing it, then quietly resent them for needing it.

3♥.name: 3 OF HEARTS
3♥.under: You keep one conversation warm on the side. Nothing happens, and nothing has to. It is an exit you leave open.
3♥.sweet_spot: Your heart gets to have range, but you don't use a new person or project as an escape from the current one.
3♥.over: You commit fully on day one, then find a dealbreaker right when the relationship starts asking you to stay.

4♥.name: 4 OF HEARTS
4♥.under: You run the household on fixed rules. It is safe, but nobody has room to change anything.
4♥.sweet_spot: Your home is a place people can count on, and you still leave space for feelings to come in unannounced.
4♥.over: When someone is upset, you reach for a plan or a schedule. Everything is in order, and it starts to feel lonely.

5♥.name: 5 OF HEARTS
5♥.under: Someone asks you to stay a little longer and you suddenly have somewhere else to be. Freedom becomes the excuse.
5♥.sweet_spot: You let love change shape over time, and you stay visible and present while it does.
5♥.over: You call it freedom, but you tend to leave right before the relationship starts asking more of you.

6♥.name: 6 OF HEARTS
6♥.under: You say 'it's fine' so often that it becomes automatic, while resentment builds underneath.
6♥.sweet_spot: You take care of people from a full tank, and you stay present as yourself while you do it.
6♥.over: You become the nice one at all costs. You swallow every disagreement, and the people you protect never learn what you wanted.

7♥.name: 7 OF HEARTS
7♥.under: You step back from the feeling and call it good judgment. It is safe, and it is lonely.
7♥.sweet_spot: You see love clearly, and you let that clarity lead you into feeling rather than replace it.
7♥.over: You live in your head and call it honesty, while the rest of you never gets a say in the relationship.

8♥.name: 8 OF HEARTS
8♥.under: You shut your feelings off and run on logic. You stay in control because nothing soft gets close.
8♥.sweet_spot: You steady the room without taking it over, and people know where they stand with you.
8♥.over: You start deciding how other people should feel. That isn't strength; it is control.

9♥.name: 9 OF HEARTS
9♥.under: You throw yourself into helping, then quietly resent the people relying on you. The ideal looked easier than it is.
9♥.sweet_spot: You stay kind and keep your hands free of burdens that belong to other people.
9♥.over: You rescue everyone except yourself, and burnout follows.

10♥.name: 10 OF HEARTS
10♥.under: You hold everyone's emotions for them, and nobody comes back to take theirs.
10♥.sweet_spot: You make room for a crowd and keep a seat in it for yourself.
10♥.over: Every mood in the room becomes your responsibility, and love starts to feel like a list of chores.

J♥.name: JACK OF HEARTS
J♥.under: You relate to the version of them you imagined. The real person never gets a fair chance.
J♥.sweet_spot: You bring a fresh angle to love, and you stay when it gets ordinary.
J♥.over: You build up the whole future before it starts, and it falls apart the first time reality asks for depth.

Q♥.name: QUEEN OF HEARTS
Q♥.under: You check everyone else's mood before your own. If they seem tired, your needs get put away.
Q♥.sweet_spot: You care for people by being present, not by constantly looking for their next need.
Q♥.over: Your care turns into control, and love starts to feel like a debt the other person never agreed to.

K♥.name: KING OF HEARTS
K♥.under: You manage everyone's feelings from a distance nobody can cross. Being untouchable is lonely.
K♥.sweet_spot: You hold emotional authority and still let people reach you.
K♥.over: You set the emotional tone and everyone follows, until people stop telling you the truth.

A♣.name: ACE OF CLUBS
A♣.under: You research the first step until it needs its own research. Lots of reading, nothing written.
A♣.sweet_spot: You put the idea out while it is still fresh and let it be rough in public so it can improve.
A♣.over: You decide you are right before anyone else has spoken, and the conversation is closed within minutes.

2♣.name: 2 OF CLUBS
2♣.under: You keep every option open so you never have to choose. It looks fair, but it is a way of putting off a decision.
2♣.sweet_spot: You think out loud with someone and still leave with an opinion that is clearly yours.
2♣.over: Winning matters more than getting the answer right, and your thinking partner becomes an opponent.

3♣.name: 3 OF CLUBS
3♣.under: You open new projects constantly, and none of them have to reach an ending.
3♣.sweet_spot: You share ideas widely and still give your full focus to the one that needs depth.
3♣.over: You have many half-finished projects and call it range. None of them stays long enough to get good.

4♣.name: 4 OF CLUBS
4♣.under: You build a system so the hard question never comes up. Structure feels safer than uncertainty.
4♣.sweet_spot: You take the confusion in everyone's head and hand it back in an order they can use.
4♣.over: Your system stopped fitting months ago and you are still defending it.

5♣.name: 5 OF CLUBS
5♣.under: You plan the change in your head over and over and never make it.
5♣.sweet_spot: You question a tired idea openly and let the better one win, even if it isn't yours.
5♣.over: You argue to prove you think faster, and the debate becomes the point.

6♣.name: 6 OF CLUBS
6♣.under: You share everything you know but downplay your own authority, so your contribution goes unseen.
6♣.sweet_spot: You share what you know and stay visible and confident while you do it.
6♣.over: You need to be the one who knows, and people end up in your lessons without asking for them.

7♣.name: 7 OF CLUBS
7♣.under: Your skepticism keeps you on the sidelines. Nothing seems solid enough, so you stay right and alone.
7♣.sweet_spot: You test every claim down to the part that holds up, then you build on that part.
7♣.over: You make the problem so complicated that nobody can act on it.

8♣.name: 8 OF CLUBS
8♣.under: You keep your sharp mind to yourself because leading would mean being seen thinking.
8♣.sweet_spot: You build a way of thinking others can follow, and you put your name on the decision.
8♣.over: Your intellect starts to silence everyone else, and being the smartest in the room becomes your only role.

9♣.name: 9 OF CLUBS
9♣.under: You keep using an old map of a situation that has changed. You call it loyalty, but it is mostly fatigue.
9♣.sweet_spot: You let go of the system that no longer works and keep the one part that still does.
9♣.over: You preach your vision, and everyone else's view gets treated as a rough draft of yours.

10♣.name: 10 OF CLUBS
10♣.under: You keep what you know to yourself instead of sharing it.
10♣.sweet_spot: You carry a lot of knowledge and keep sharing it generously with others.
10♣.over: You control access to information, and your authority depends on everyone else staying a step behind.

J♣.name: JACK OF CLUBS
J♣.under: You release the idea before it is ready, and speed replaces checking whether it works.
J♣.sweet_spot: You bring the unusual new angle and hand it to someone whose job is to test it first.
J♣.over: You pitch the idea before you know it can survive outside your head. Excitement runs ahead of the work.

Q♣.name: QUEEN OF CLUBS
Q♣.under: You keep half of what you know to yourself to keep the peace.
Q♣.sweet_spot: You teach from what you know, and nobody has to prove themselves to hear it.
Q♣.over: You decide who is ready to know things, and knowledge becomes something you hand out selectively.

K♣.name: KING OF CLUBS
K♣.under: You avoid making the call while privately believing you already know the answer.
K♣.sweet_spot: You make the decision openly and stay willing to revise it.
K♣.over: You treat disagreement as error, and people learn to nod instead of think.

A♦.name: ACE OF DIAMONDS
A♦.under: You hold on to what you have and keep imagining losing it, while the real plan for security never gets made.
A♦.sweet_spot: You start new things because you believe you can create value and keep it.
A♦.over: You pile up money as if it proves your worth, and friendships start to feel like competitions.

2♦.name: 2 OF DIAMONDS
2♦.under: You take the smaller share so nobody can call you greedy, then keep a private tally of what you are owed.
2♦.sweet_spot: You agree on who pays for what up front, and both sides come out even.
2♦.over: You use money to keep control. Whoever pays decides, and you make sure you are the one paying.

3♦.name: 3 OF DIAMONDS
3♦.under: You have several side projects and none of them earns enough to matter. Each one is something you are afraid to close.
3♦.sweet_spot: You run a few income streams and each one brings in real money.
3♦.over: You chase the next opportunity before the current one has paid off.

4♦.name: 4 OF DIAMONDS
4♦.under: You save against every possible disaster and forget to live in the life you are protecting.
4♦.sweet_spot: You build a solid financial base and still spend when the situation calls for it.
4♦.over: You keep money locked up even when holding on costs more than spending would.

5♦.name: 5 OF DIAMONDS
5♦.under: You are so afraid of losing that you don't choose at all, and not choosing becomes your safe bet.
5♦.sweet_spot: When circumstances change, you adjust the budget and admit that things changed.
5♦.over: You spend to feel like you are moving, and call the chaos freedom.

6♦.name: 6 OF DIAMONDS
6♦.under: You cover for everyone and never ask for anything back. Generosity becomes a way to avoid asking.
6♦.sweet_spot: You give freely and still keep your own needs on the list.
6♦.over: Every favor comes with an expectation, and helping becomes a way to keep people obligated.

7♦.name: 7 OF DIAMONDS
7♦.under: You check your accounts looking for a disaster the numbers don't show, and worry takes over your time.
7♦.sweet_spot: You know your worth is bigger than the number in your account.
7♦.over: Extra money feels like a mistake about to be corrected, and scarcity thinking stays long after the facts have changed.

8♦.name: 8 OF DIAMONDS
8♦.under: You hand control of money or decisions to someone less able, because taking charge feels uncomfortable.
8♦.sweet_spot: You make money decisions openly and can give a clear reason for each one.
8♦.over: You start managing people like budget lines and expect them to stay in their place.

9♦.name: 9 OF DIAMONDS
9♦.under: You keep giving when you have nothing left, and you get uncomfortable when someone gives to you.
9♦.sweet_spot: You give an amount you can keep giving, and you let people give back.
9♦.over: You keep playing the generous one after it stops being sustainable, and bitterness replaces the no you should have said.

10♦.name: 10 OF DIAMONDS
10♦.under: You support relatives or others so fully that your own growth stays capped.
10♦.sweet_spot: You earn enough and structure it so it lasts.
10♦.over: People start to look like tools for your success, and you forget who helped you get there.

J♦.name: JACK OF DIAMONDS
J♦.under: A new money idea excites you, and a few weeks into the real work you lose interest.
J♦.sweet_spot: You try the new money idea and stay with it long enough to get real results.
J♦.over: You sell the result before you have done the work, and the product exists mostly as an idea.

Q♦.name: QUEEN OF DIAMONDS
Q♦.under: You have plenty and still ration as if disaster is coming. Control takes the place of trust.
Q♦.sweet_spot: You keep things secure without treating every purchase as a crisis.
Q♦.over: Your love comes with a price, and everyone knows what disappointing you costs.

K♦.name: KING OF DIAMONDS
K♦.under: You hold back resources and stay silent, and everyone still works around the money you won't use.
K♦.sweet_spot: You run things well and your reasoning is visible to everyone.
K♦.over: Your team becomes a means to your status, and taking care of people stops being part of the job.

A♠.name: ACE OF SPADES
A♠.under: You sit on bad news and give everyone a softened version.
A♠.sweet_spot: You name the problem while it is still small enough to fix, without waiting for a crisis.
A♠.over: You use the truth as a weapon, then blame the other person for how it landed.

2♠.name: 2 OF SPADES
2♠.under: You keep researching until the deadline passes. Diligence becomes a hiding place.
2♠.sweet_spot: You weigh two real pressures and still make a decision that works in practice.
2♠.over: Your refusal to decide gets so loud that the people around you end up fighting over it for you.

3♠.name: 3 OF SPADES
3♠.under: Sadness takes over, and nothing else gets attention until the feeling passes, which can take a long time.
3♠.sweet_spot: You let the hard feeling in, understand what it is telling you, and then keep going.
3♠.over: Your pain becomes the final argument, and people who did nothing wrong get cast as the cause.

4♠.name: 4 OF SPADES
4♠.under: You shut out anything new and call it stability.
4♠.sweet_spot: You build enough structure that things can change without everything falling apart.
4♠.over: You stay defensive long after the threat has passed.

5♠.name: 5 OF SPADES
5♠.under: You freeze when conflict starts and blame the situation for everything.
5♠.sweet_spot: You stay through the hard part until you get better at it.
5♠.over: You keep a fight ready to prove you are tough, and peace starts to feel like losing.

6♠.name: 6 OF SPADES
6♠.under: You take care of everyone else's wounds and ignore your own. Helping becomes a way to avoid your own issues.
6♠.sweet_spot: What you have been through becomes useful to others, without anyone else having to suffer for it to count.
6♠.over: Your help needs someone to rescue, and when nobody is struggling you feel restless.

7♠.name: 7 OF SPADES
7♠.under: You jump to the worst case and ignore the useful version.
7♠.sweet_spot: You name the difficult pattern, then take one honest step before dread takes over.
7♠.over: Difficulty becomes your whole outlook, and every good fact gets treated as a trap.

8♠.name: 8 OF SPADES
8♠.under: You put down responsibility and resent whoever picks it up.
8♠.sweet_spot: You take on the hard decision, then keep showing up for the routine work after it.
8♠.over: You steer everything with sheer force of mind. Everyone agrees, and nobody tells you what is going on.

9♠.name: 9 OF SPADES
9♠.under: You leave an ending unfinished because finishing would mean starting over without it.
9♠.sweet_spot: You get through the hard chapter, keep the lesson, and let go of the rest.
9♠.over: You close things off before the work is done, and ending becomes your way out.

10♠.name: 10 OF SPADES
10♠.under: You take on everyone's hardest tasks and call it responsibility.
10♠.sweet_spot: You do the hard work in front of you and decline work that belongs to someone else.
10♠.over: You keep raising the standard until nobody can meet it, including you, and effort replaces judgment.

J♠.name: JACK OF SPADES
J♠.under: You say the truth in passing and leave the consequences to others.
J♠.sweet_spot: You name the situation plainly, then stay present.
J♠.over: Honesty becomes a way to score points, and people feel the sting before they hear the information.

Q♠.name: QUEEN OF SPADES
Q♠.under: You know what is going on and let someone's mistaken view stand to keep the peace.
Q♠.sweet_spot: You say what needs saying in a way the other person can use.
Q♠.over: You hold back key information to stay ahead, and knowledge becomes leverage.

K♠.name: KING OF SPADES
K♠.under: You retreat into your head and shut out feelings, so leading feels easier but nobody can reach you.
K♠.sweet_spot: You make the tough decision and still let people see the person behind it.
K♠.over: Emotions get treated as problems to fix, and people stop bringing you anything personal.
